title: Tolvi decision frontmatter
description: Frontmatter schema for files in vault/decisions/.

tags.description: Tags describing the doc. The first tag SHOULD be 'decision'. Case-sensitive; no duplicates.

date.description: ISO-8601 date matching the filename date prefix.

repo.description: The repo this decision binds to (slug).

ticket.description: Optional. Free-form issue tracker reference, URL, or 'none'.

supersedes.description: Optional. Slug of an older decision this one replaces.

superseded_by.description: Optional. Slug of a newer decision that replaces this one. Required when status is 'superseded'.

user_impact.description: Who feels this decision and how much. Free text rather than an enum: the useful answer is usually a phrase, and a fixed scale invites picking a label over saying what changes.

product_area.description: The part of the product this decision governs, as the authoring team names it. Free text, since the areas differ per project and a shared enum would be wrong for everyone.

visibility.description: Whether this doc is internal. `private` routes it to the nearest declared private root above its scope; absent or `public` keeps it in the root that owns its scope. Sessions do not carry this field: they always route private except in single-root mode, so the resolver never consults it for them.
